name: toolkit
description: Codex-ready PR-filing, goal-handoff, claim-check, qa-sweep, empirical-proof, code-quality-review, doc-to-html, ui-demo-video, route-work, arch-map, and fix-ci skills and bundled agent files (reviewers + ci-watcher) from Agent Workshop.

interface.shortDescription: Handoff and doc-to-html skills for Codex.
interface.longDescription: A Codex manifest for the Agent Workshop toolkit plugin. Codex exposes the file-pr, handoff-goal, doc-to-html, claim-check, qa-sweep, empirical-proof, code-quality-review, get-pr-comments, ui-demo-video, route-work, arch-map, and fix-ci skills from this package; the agent files (the reviewers plus ci-watcher) are bundled in the payload for Claude Code and reference, but Codex standalone custom agents still need repo-local .codex/agents wrappers.
defaultPrompt: File the branch's PR and see it through to green and mergeable.
Turn a markdown report into a standalone HTML page.
Investigate whether a ticket or claim still holds.
Run a team-scale QA sweep over a release and corroborate the findings.
Empirically prove a just-finished change at the running app.
Run a strict code quality review on the current branch.
Summarize the active PR's review comments into a prioritized action list.
Record a UI demo video of a change in the running app.
Recommend a model and effort route for a task before dispatching it.
Draw an architecture map of a subsystem or refactor as a standalone page.
Watch the current branch's CI and fix whatever breaks.
Explain how to install reviewer agents for Codex.
